governance.purpose: Derive explicit, gene-specific input/output contracts from each approved gene's responsibility, invariant anchors, dependencies, permitted effects, authority requirements, evidence requirements, failure semantics and compatibility policy.
governance.approval_boundary: All field-level definitions, enumerations and rejection semantics in this proposal require Owner approval before they become normative schemas.

schema_convention.internal_refs: only local fragment references within the same schema; resolver must detect missing targets and cycles

contracts.title: Identity root
contracts.purpose: identity root identifier, issuer identity, root key fingerprint, activation epoch, trust status

positive_vector.description: valid active root accepted; revoked root rejected

negative_vector.description: unknown issuer or revoked root

contracts.title: Identity lineage
contracts.purpose: subject identity, predecessor identity, succession proof, lineage epoch

positive_vector.description: valid acyclic chain accepted; cycle rejected

negative_vector.description: cycle or missing succession proof

contracts.title: Identity compatibility
contracts.purpose: source identity version, target version, compatibility declaration, migration evidence

positive_vector.description: explicit compatible pair accepted; undeclared pair rejected

negative_vector.description: implicit major-version compatibility

contracts.title: Authority source
contracts.purpose: authority principal, source class, mandate reference, validity interval

positive_vector.description: valid mandate accepted; expired mandate rejected

negative_vector.description: expired or unrecognized authority source

contracts.title: Owner governance
contracts.purpose: owner principal, decision request, scope, signed approval, expiry

positive_vector.description: valid signed approval accepted; forged signature rejected

negative_vector.description: unsigned or scope-mismatched Owner approval

contracts.title: Decision register
contracts.purpose: decision identifier, authority, decision text digest, status, supersession link

positive_vector.description: unique immutable decision recorded; conflicting duplicate rejected

negative_vector.description: duplicate ID with conflicting digest

contracts.title: Premise model
contracts.purpose: premise statements, source references, confidence values, context

positive_vector.description: well-formed sourced premises normalized; unsupported premise flagged

negative_vector.description: premise lacks source or invalid confidence

contracts.title: Inference rules
contracts.purpose: rule set, premise references, inference request, rule version

positive_vector.description: valid rule chain produces trace; unknown rule rejected

negative_vector.description: rule references missing premise or unknown rule version

contracts.title: Uncertainty calculus
contracts.purpose: hypotheses, evidence weights, calibration profile, calculation method

positive_vector.description: bounded weights calculated; invalid weights rejected

negative_vector.description: non-finite or out-of-range weights

contracts.title: Knowledge schema
contracts.purpose: knowledge type, field definitions, constraints, schema version

positive_vector.description: unique typed fields accepted; duplicate fields rejected

negative_vector.description: duplicate field names or unsupported type

contracts.title: Provenance chain
contracts.purpose: artifact digest, ordered source events, actor references, prior chain digest

positive_vector.description: continuous chain verifies; broken link rejected

negative_vector.description: broken digest link or missing event actor

contracts.title: Conflict model
contracts.purpose: claims, source identifiers, claim relations, conflict policy

positive_vector.description: contradictions surfaced; silent overwrite rejected

negative_vector.description: conflicting claims silently overwritten

contracts.title: Memory classification
contracts.purpose: memory item, sensitivity labels, purpose, owner, data class

positive_vector.description: recognized class maps to controls; unknown class quarantined

negative_vector.description: unknown classification label

contracts.title: Retention control
contracts.purpose: memory reference, retention rule, legal hold, expiry event

positive_vector.description: valid policy computes deadline; active hold prevents expiry

negative_vector.description: deletion despite active legal hold

contracts.title: Memory integrity checkpoint
contracts.purpose: memory snapshot digest, sequence, prior checkpoint, checkpoint authority

positive_vector.description: monotonic checkpoint accepted; rollback rejected

negative_vector.description: sequence rollback or digest mismatch

contracts.title: Input envelope
contracts.purpose: source, media type, payload digest, payload length, capture time, untrusted payload reference

positive_vector.description: matching envelope accepted as untrusted input; tampered envelope rejected

negative_vector.description: digest/length mismatch or unsupported media type

contracts.title: Source trust
contracts.purpose: source identity, credential reference, trust policy, observed signature, revocation snapshot

positive_vector.description: valid credential assessed; revoked source never trusted

negative_vector.description: revoked credential or stale revocation state

contracts.title: Perception transform
contracts.purpose: input envelope, transform identifier/version, modality, declared output type

positive_vector.description: declared transform yields traceable output; mismatched version rejected

negative_vector.description: transform version mismatch or undeclared output type

contracts.title: Agent principal
contracts.purpose: agent identifier, identity credential, runtime instance, principal class

positive_vector.description: bound principal accepted; revoked identity rejected

negative_vector.description: revoked or unbound agent identity

contracts.title: Capability profile
contracts.purpose: agent principal, requested capabilities, resource limits, policy version

positive_vector.description: only policy-allowed capabilities listed; escalation denied

negative_vector.description: capability exceeds policy or attempts privilege escalation

contracts.title: Delegation boundary
contracts.purpose: delegator, delegate, capability subset, expiry, delegation proof

positive_vector.description: strict subset accepted; scope escalation rejected

negative_vector.description: delegate scope exceeds delegator or expired delegation

contracts.title: Workflow graph
contracts.purpose: workflow identifier, nodes, edges, dependency constraints, graph version

positive_vector.description: acyclic graph ordered; cycle rejected

negative_vector.description: cycle or dangling edge

contracts.title: Scheduler policy
contracts.purpose: task classes, priorities, quotas, deadlines, scheduling policy

positive_vector.description: valid constraints normalized; impossible schedule reported

negative_vector.description: negative quota or impossible deadline silently accepted

contracts.title: Coordination state
contracts.purpose: workflow run, participant states, lease epochs, checkpoint references

positive_vector.description: newer epoch wins; stale writer rejected

negative_vector.description: stale lease epoch overwrites newer state

contracts.title: Effect contract
contracts.purpose: requested effect, target, resource scope, risk class, operation digest

positive_vector.description: declared effect contract evaluated; undeclared effect rejected

negative_vector.description: undeclared or prohibited effect

contracts.title: Admission gate
contracts.purpose: effect contract, signed authorization, policy snapshot, expiry and replay nonce

positive_vector.description: valid scoped authorization admits; invalid/replayed authorization denied

negative_vector.description: missing, invalid, expired or replayed authorization

contracts.title: Execution receipt
contracts.purpose: admission record, executor identity, operation result digest, start/end timestamps

positive_vector.description: receipt binds to admission; orphan receipt rejected

negative_vector.description: receipt without admission or mismatched executor

contracts.title: Learning input
contracts.purpose: observations, source trust references, data class, consent/authorization context

positive_vector.description: eligible data isolated; prohibited input excluded

negative_vector.description: untrusted, unauthorized or prohibited data class

contracts.title: Change proposal
contracts.purpose: target component/version, proposed diff digest, rationale, expected effects, proposer

positive_vector.description: proposal recorded for evaluation; invariant breach blocked

negative_vector.description: proposal changes invariant or bypasses approval

contracts.title: Evaluation record
contracts.purpose: proposal, test suite digest, baseline metrics, candidate metrics, evaluator identity

positive_vector.description: complete evaluation recorded; missing evidence is inconclusive

negative_vector.description: missing baseline or evaluator provenance

contracts.title: Validator
contracts.purpose: artifact reference, applicable contracts, validator version, policy snapshot

positive_vector.description: known contracts checked; unknown contract fails closed

negative_vector.description: unknown contract or validator version

contracts.title: Attestation
contracts.purpose: subject digest, validation record, attester identity, signing key reference, challenge nonce

positive_vector.description: fresh valid signature accepted; replay/revocation rejected

negative_vector.description: signature mismatch, replayed challenge or revoked key

contracts.title: Conformance report
contracts.purpose: suite identifier/version, test results, tested commit, environment digest

positive_vector.description: complete exact-head report accepted; missing result blocks pass

negative_vector.description: missing test result or SHA mismatch

contracts.title: Mutation policy
contracts.purpose: proposed mutation, target gene/version, risk class, protected invariant set, approval reference

positive_vector.description: policy classifies and gates change; unauthorized mutation denied

negative_vector.description: unapproved protected mutation or invariant weakening

contracts.title: Version lineage
contracts.purpose: candidate artifact digest, parent version/digest, mutation record, epoch

positive_vector.description: linked monotonic lineage accepted; broken ancestry rejected

negative_vector.description: missing parent digest or non-monotonic epoch

contracts.title: Rollback guard
contracts.purpose: current epoch/digest, candidate epoch/digest, revocation floor, rollback authorization

positive_vector.description: permitted forward transition accepted; rollback below floor denied

negative_vector.description: candidate below revocation floor or stale epoch

normative_constraints: These proposed field lists are not claims about fields already approved in Genome v1.0.0.
The schema must not grant authority: data declaring a capability or approval is not itself a runtime authorization.
G09 effect admission requires separate operation-specific authorization; no schema validation alone authorizes execution.
G10 learning and G12 evolution proposals do not self-approve or self-deploy.
All security-sensitive validation failures are fail-closed as required by the gene contracts.
No additionalProperties are accepted unless a future explicitly versioned extension contract allows them.
acceptance_gates: Owner approves or amends every gene's input and output field definitions.
All 72 schemas use exact stable IDs, versions and Draft 2020-12 dialect.
All 72 Genome references resolve to exactly one schema and no schema is orphaned or duplicated.
Every schema parses and passes meta-schema validation.
Every internal $ref resolves; external references and reference cycles are rejected unless explicitly approved.
All 36 conformance cases contain positive and negative fixtures and assert both input and output behavior.
All fixtures run against the exact candidate commit SHA; results and environment digest are recorded.
known_open_questions: Confirm whether provenance and version-bound evidence are represented as embedded objects or references in each data model.
Confirm canonical timestamp format (recommend RFC 3339 UTC).
Confirm digest algorithms and canonical serialization rules.
Confirm whether enumerations such as trust_level, outcome and decision are closed sets or extensible versioned vocabularies.
Confirm stable public schema URI ownership and whether iroka.dev is the intended permanent namespace.
